explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1009: for every c>0 there is f(c) such that a graph with at least ⌊n²/4⌋+k edges, k<cn, has at least k-f(c) edge-disjoint triangles. ℕ division is the floor, k≤|T|+f avoids truncated subtraction, and pairwise intersections of size ≤1 is edge-disjointness. Faithful; proved by Győri per the page.
